package.name: arx_camera_bringup
package.description:
Bringing the real camera up on the robot. A replacement for turtlebot3_bringup's camera launch, which hardcodes a sensor mode belonging to a different camera module.
Nothing in here runs in simulation and nothing in arx_mission needs it, which is why it is a package of its own: it is copied to the Pi and built there, and the development machine never builds it at all.
